title: Effects of changing dysfunctional beliefs in avatar-based cognitive therapy on symptoms of obsessive-compulsive disorder
summary: Negative thought patterns play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of various mental disorders, including obsessive-compulsive disorder. Recent research findings indicate that digital, avatar-based interventions can be helpful in changing such negative thought patterns and alleviating symptoms in various disorders. The aim of the present study is to investigate the effects of an avatar-based intervention on symptoms of obsessive-compulsive disorders.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
A score of 0.67 or higher on the “Compulsion” subscale of the ICD-10 Symptom Rating (ISR) was defined as an inclusion criterion.
Exclusion criteria:
Participants with visual or hearing impairments or limited German language skills were excluded. Participants with a history of or current episodes of psychosis or mania, as well as those currently undergoing psychotherapy.
